name: io.github.bjyoe2016/dyoe-trust-mcp
title: DYOE Trust Tools (x402)
description: 22 pay-per-call x402 tools for agents: scam checks, payment pre-flight, approvals, data. USDC/Base

environmentVariables.name: WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Key of a dedicated, low-balance Base wallet holding USDC; pays each call via x402. Unset = free preview (returns the 402 quote).

environmentVariables.name: DYOE_MAX_PAYMENT_USD
environmentVariables.description: Optional per-call payment cap in USD (default 0.10). /review costs $15 and needs a higher cap.
